title: LLM intermediate: requirement slices
description: Atomic requirement candidates extracted from a canonical document model. Every slice must either cite evidence (supported) or declare gaps (not_found) with blocking questions—no silent invention.

canonical_document_ref.description: Opaque client-provided reference to the parsed document bundle (no server-side storage required).

document_title.description: Optional short label inferred from the brief (still subject to traceability rules on slices).

block_id.description: Stable id from the canonical document model (e.g. p-042, li-003-002, t-01-r-2-c-3).

quote.description: Verbatim substring from the referenced block; used by the deterministic verifier.

question_id.description: Stable id for round-trips; client echoes answers keyed by this id.

rationale.description: Why this cannot be grounded in the brief (missing field, conflict, etc.).

statement.description: Single atomic requirement phrased for downstream ticketification.

status.description: supported: grounded in evidence; not_found: not stated clearly in the brief—must ask.

evidence.description: One or more citations when status is supported; may be empty only when status is not_found.

blocking_questions.description: Must be non-empty when status is not_found; may be empty or populated when status is supported.
